lyrics:
[Intro: soft electric piano, brushed drums, a low string note]

[Verse 1: hushed, close, almost shy]
You walked in like a matinee
I forgot what I came to say
Pardon me if I lose my place
I've been reading the same line of your face

[Verse 2: hushed, a little warmer]
Thirty years across a table
Still can't look away, still not able
Pass the butter, pass the news
I keep on looking, I can't choose

[Horn Build: horns climb step by step, drums push, crowd sings]
Ba-da, ba-da, ba-da-da-da-da
Ba-da, ba-da, ba-da-da-da-da

[Chorus: explosive, full band and horns, shouted with joy]
Oh, let me stare a little
Let me look a while
I've waited all my life, it seems
To catch that kind of smile
Oh, let me stare a little
Don't you turn away
If looking is a crime, then lock me up
And throw away the day

[Verse 3: hushed again, strings]
You'll say "what?" and I'll say "nothing"
You'll say "stop" and you'll be bluffing
There's a grey now in your hair
I put some of it there

[Horn Build: horns climb step by step, drums push, crowd sings]
Ba-da, ba-da, ba-da-da-da-da
Ba-da, ba-da, ba-da-da-da-da

[Final Chorus: everything, crowd singing, horns blazing]
Oh, let me stare a little
Let me look a while
I've waited all my life, it seems
To catch that kind of smile
Oh, let me stare a little
Don't you turn away
If looking is a crime, then lock me up
And throw away the day

[Outro: horn figure repeats, crowd, fade]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 124 BPM, 4/4, E major. Hushed and swaying in the verses, then a brassy, striding shout. Two moods joined by a fanfare.

VOICE: Male tenor. In the verses he sings softly and close, almost shyly, in a light head voice. In the chorus he opens into a full, ringing, joyful belt. A crowd of voices sings the horn build and the last chorus with him.

INSTRUMENTS: Electric piano and a soft, brushed drum kit in the verses. A big horn section (trumpets, trombones, saxophones) that plays a climbing figure in a clear, clap-along rhythm and then blazes through the chorus. Electric bass. A string section. Rhythm guitar. Tambourine.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, electric piano. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Verse 2. 0:58 Horn build. 1:10 Chorus 1. 1:42 Verse 3, hushed. 2:06 Horn build. 2:18 Final chorus with the crowd. 2:50 Outro, the horn figure repeating, fading by 3:00.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-1960s big-band pop: warm and intimate in the verses, wide, bright and brassy in the chorus.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The horn build at 0:58, which tells every listener when to come in.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The disbelief is not at a stranger's beauty. It is that after thirty years across a table he still cannot look away. The line about grey hair is the kind of joke long marriages run on.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Shy wonder, an outburst, tenderness, a bigger outburst.
